study_type: Warm-start engineering pilot; not a confirmatory or from-scratch study
noise_units: Absolute observation units: eight position coordinates, then nine velocities; no fitted normalizer
old_replay_collection: Fresh deterministic clean-condition episodes from the frozen pretrained model; same pool for both replay arms
checkpoint_rule: Fixed budgets only; no selection from sensor-test or retention performance
endpoints: B return at each fixed budget
A return change from zero-step model
Trapezoidal mean B return across the 0-4000 step curve
inference_limitations: Three training seeds and three evaluation episodes are a pilot. No equivalence, no-forgetting, success-rate, or arbitrary-new-environment claim. No recovery-time threshold is asserted.
warm_start_limitations: Source checkpoints were trained on actuator perturbations. A is a clean evaluation condition, not a newly trained clean-only task. Optimizers and entropy temperature were not archived and are initialized anew for every branch.
